title: Module 1: Emergency Detection & Sensor Intelligence
description: Multi-mode trigger system supporting manual touch, gesture accelerometer shaking, and automatic fall detection patterns.

stories.title: As an elderly user, I want to trigger an SOS by vigorously shaking my phone when I cannot look at the screen
stories.acceptanceCriteria: Accelerometer event detects acceleration magnitude > 25 m/s2 across 3 consecutive spikes and initiates 5s emergency countdown.

stories.title: As an emergency responder, I want automatic fall detection simulation so that sudden drop impacts alert caregivers
stories.acceptanceCriteria: High g-force impact followed by zero motion triggers high-priority distress payload with mode='fall'.

stories.title: As a paramedic, I want vital medical details (Blood group, allergies, chronic illness) included in every SOS payload
stories.acceptanceCriteria: Emergency payload attaches medical-profile data and displays prominently on caregiver dashboard.

title: Module 2: Adaptive Decision Engine & Communication Failover
description: Dynamic multi-channel selection evaluating signal strength, battery, latency, and historical reliability.

features.title: Dynamic Channel Scoring (Cellular vs SMS vs LoRa Mesh)

stories.title: As an emergency system, evaluate network metrics every 3 seconds and select the optimal transmission pathway
stories.acceptanceCriteria: Score = 30% Signal + 25% Latency + 20% Battery + 25% Historical Success Rate.

stories.title: As a user in dead zones, automatically fallback to SMS gateway with Google Maps coordinates
stories.acceptanceCriteria: When signal < -95 dBm, system designates SMS Gateway fallback.

title: Module 3: Caregiver Command Dashboard & Live Telemetry
description: Real-time command center displaying interactive Leaflet GPS mapping, live breadcrumbs, audio sirens, and contact management.

stories.title: As a caregiver, I want to track the movement path of the victim in real time via GPS breadcrumbs
stories.acceptanceCriteria: Active SOS continuously transmits coordinate breadcrumbs every 10 seconds; dashboard draws polyline trail.

stories.title: As a caregiver, hear an audible siren alarm and push notification when a distress signal arrives
stories.acceptanceCriteria: Browser AudioContext plays repeating alarm audio and browser native notification displays alert.

title: Module 4: Azure DevOps CI/CD & Delivery Assurance
description: Automated pipelines, containerization, automated API testing, and delivery assurance protocols.

stories.title: As a software engineering team, execute automated test suite on every pull request using Azure Pipelines
stories.acceptanceCriteria: azure-pipelines.yml runs npm test on ubuntu-latest and validates all endpoints.

stories.title: As a DevOps engineer, produce Docker container image for deployment to Azure App Service
stories.acceptanceCriteria: Dockerfile builds multi-stage Node.js alpine container with healthcheck.
